description: This Java source file defines the MakeDictionaryPlugin class, which implements a Gradle plugin for building dictionaries. It includes methods for retrieving project properties, configuring tasks for merging word lists, generating dictionaries from AOSP files, prebuilt XMLs, and text inputs, and setting up task dependencies based on project properties.

classes.name: MakeDictionaryPlugin
classes.description: A Gradle plugin class that automates the process of creating dictionaries for an Android project, including merging word lists, parsing AOSP files, and handling prebuilt and input text files.
